note: Improvements to existing public repos, scored per RUBRIC.md section 5. priority = impact * confidence / effort.

items.title: Add the profile README on the peebee1 account
items.defect: The account has no profile README. A visitor lands on a bare repo list with 0 followers and no thesis.
items.fintech_angle: Lead with the thesis: AI agents for fintech and commerce, built in the open, with links to the proofs.

items.title: Fix the wall-clock test that broke on its own
items.defect: test_human_age_and_freshness fails because freshness_line calls datetime.now while the test asserts against a fixed date. The suite rots every time max_age_days elapses.
items.fintech_angle: Deterministic time is a payments requirement, not a test detail. Inject now() everywhere.

items.title: Make the test suite runnable from a clean checkout
items.defect: pytest is not in requirements.txt. uv run pytest fails with no such executable, so the 5 test files have never run in CI.
items.fintech_angle: A trading agent with unrunnable tests is a liability story, not a portfolio story.

items.title: Add CI to the ACP proof of concept
items.defect: 39 tests pass locally, no workflow file exists. Nothing proves green on push.
items.fintech_angle: Conformance tests are the whole argument of that repo. They must run where people can see them.

items.title: Add CI to shopping-concierge
items.defect: 61 tests, 8 files, no workflow. The failing test would have been caught on day one.
items.fintech_angle: Same argument: if the eval harness is the claim, CI has to run it.

items.title: Add CI and a frozen mock benchmark to agent-bazaar
items.defect: 43 tests pass, no workflow. The README quotes LLM negotiation results that nobody can reproduce without the same model.
items.fintech_angle: Publish a deterministic mock-mode benchmark table that CI regenerates, and keep the LLM run as a recorded artifact.

items.title: Add repository topics and sharper descriptions
items.defect: No repo topics on any public repo, and descriptions read like internal notes rather than a thesis.
items.fintech_angle: Topics are the discovery surface for agentic commerce, payments, reconciliation, and stablecoin search.

items.title: Rewrite the Angel One README around risk, not returns
items.defect: The README leads with the mandate size. It does not state what the agent proves, what the rails forbid, or what happened in the 60 days.
items.fintech_angle: The interesting claim is the guardrails: what the agent is structurally unable to do. Lead with that.

items.title: Make the ACP benchmark a committed results file
items.defect: bench/results.md is prose. There is no machine-readable result and no threshold that fails a regression.
items.fintech_angle: Latency and idempotency under concurrency are the claims a payments reviewer actually checks.

items.title: Refresh the stale catalog and eval numbers
items.defect: Committed data is 79 days old and the eval report quotes stale freshness labels.
items.fintech_angle: Refresh via the crawler so the numbers are reproducible from the repo, and state the crawl date.
